crossRefs.note: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
I know that the king of Egypt won’t give you permission to go, no, not by a mighty hand.
I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do among them, and after that he will let…
Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by…
and Yahweh showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;
and showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, and against all his servants, and against all the people of his land; for…
He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

people.name: Egypt

people.name: Zoan
